reason: I'd love to post a numbered can, but 649 CZK plus shipping is a big chunk of my month on about 11k a month. I'd grab a free tasting can at a launch event or one at a café first, not commit to twelve blind.
objection: Over 50 CZK a can is Monster money for something I've never tasted, and with an English label I'm not even sure it's really a Czech thing or just hype.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting it for free and liking it, then being able to buy a 4-pack or single cans on Rohlík instead of a whole 12-pack.
